items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: But I think it’s useful to keep that distinction except when Bill Monroe wanted to play a blues or something and then he’d get the bass up there and Bill could sing the blues right up there with Bob Wills and Brownie McGee.

ctx.x: And so beginning in the early 30s the western bands like the Light Crust Doughboys and Bob Wills and Milton Brown — they all had bass players. Then up in Chicago the Barn Dance on WLS — am I getting that wrong — anyway the Saturday Night Barn Dance out of Chicago — my memory’s got huge holes in it — who had the Kentucky Ramblers and the leader was a bass player, Roy Acuff’s hit records from the mid-30s from Knoxville with Knoxville people were the ones that had a string bass in it. And I think the presence or…
In the pantheon of American music bluegrass is not all that old, is it? Or, the things I’ve read they stated 1940. Is that debatable?
